descriptions.zh: 收縮壓目標與一般成人接近（110–129），但舒張壓門檻收緊到 80，80–84 這一段在一般成人只是「偏高觀察」，在這裡就算超出目標。
descriptions.id: Target sistolik mirip dewasa umum (110–129), tetapi ambang diastolik diperketat ke 80; rentang 80–84 yang pada dewasa umum hanya "observasi" di sini sudah dihitung di atas target.
descriptions.en: The systolic target is close to the general adult one (110–129), but the diastolic threshold is tightened to 80: the 80–84 band that general adults only "observe" already counts as above target here.
